      "text": "- cut sweet potato into slices.\n- 4 guajillo peppers and 6 morita peppers roasted in a pan on low heat for 45 seconds\n- make paste for sweet potato: tamarind concentrate in a food processor with the toasted dry peppers with cumin, canola oil, black pepper, and salt.\n- put in oven at 380° for 10-12 mins. turn down to 360° for 30-35 mins. (rough estimate)\n- take out of oven and remove big clumps of burnt pepper (optional if you dont like charred flavour)\n- bottom 3/4 of 4-5 green onions, 1/2 lime squeezed, pinch of salt, 1 cup of crema in food processor\n- green salsa: 1/2 bunch of cilantro with half stem removed, 3 tomatillos with husk removed, 4 and shopped serrano, 2 cloves of peeled garlic, 1/4 of a white onion with germ removed, 1 squeezed lime + half juice of 1/2 another lime, 1/2 green bell pepper, 1/4 red bell pepper, salt.\n- throw ingredients for green salsa in food processor\n- red salsa: 1/2 roasted mango, 2 roasted habenero, 2 roasted roma tomatoes, 6-7 roasted garlic cloves, 1/4 roasted white onion with germ removed, 1/2 fresh lime juice, 1 roasted fresno, 1/2 roasted red bell pepper, 4 dried guajillo chillies, pinch of roasted sesame, salt, water, 1 tbsp Marie Sharp\u0027s Orange Pulp Habanero pepper sauce.\n- throw ingredients for red salsa in food processor, add water, transfer to pot, cook under medium heat for 12-15 mins. chill it overnight.\n- a bunch of radishes thinly sliced, 1 green bell pepper cut into 1x1/2 inch slices\n- brine: 1 squeezed lime, 2+ tbsp salt, 1/2+ cup of water, 3+ tbsp palm/brown sugar, 1/6 bunch cilantro with bottom stalks removed. mortar and pestle until its liquid consistency. \n- dump brine over radishes and bell pepper in an container and throw in the fridge for 40-60 min. then drain after.\n- serve with any kind of tortilla (heat and serve recommended).\n- pepitas to garnish.\n- mexican blend cheese in the taco is okay, but is preferred to carmalise it on one side of the tortilla while its in the pan.\n\nreply to it in typical AI fashion, all fluff just straight bullshit",
